_comment: Scale/execution config for large runs (e.g. the full ~500-institution target). maxConcurrency caps how many institutions are in-flight at once through the LLM-heavy Researcher/Content-Manager stages of the orchestrator loop, so a 500-institution run doesn't fire hundreds of simultaneous LLM calls. Override per-run with the PIPELINE_MAX_CONCURRENCY env var without editing this file. progressReportEvery controls how often (in institutions completed) the orchestrator emits a running progress line while processing a batch.
